findings.title: Node canonicalization violates UTF-8 key order for integer-index names
findings.observation: Object.fromEntries reconstructs a JavaScript object after sorting. JSON.stringify then enumerates integer-index properties numerically, overriding that sort. Rust serializes keys lexicographically.
findings.impact: Both key names are accepted by the documented generic scalar JSON subset. Node and Rust produce different frames, digests and signature messages for this valid statement. Existing fixture and astral/BMP vectors miss the defect; their recorded results remain valid for their exact inputs.
findings.required_change: Serialize object members directly in sorted UTF-8 order instead of round-tripping through JavaScript property enumeration, or consistently narrow both accepted subsets. Add a Node/Rust golden regression with integer-index keys at multiple nesting levels, then regenerate/freeze and rerun required tests/audits.
